info.title: Flexera Global Resource Service
info.description:
DEPRECATED / LEGACY — hand-curated OpenAPI subset for the Flexera Global Resource Service (GRS).

GRS is a legacy internal Praxis (Ruby) application in the process of being deprecated. It does not publish a real upstream OpenAPI document.

This file is hand-maintained and intentionally documents only the GRS endpoints that the unified Flexera One SDK helpers depend on (currently project/org lookup by user). Add new endpoints only when an SDK helper requires them; remove this spec once GRS is fully deprecated and no helpers depend on it.

zone.description: com = NAM, eu = EU, au = APAC

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Flexera user ID (numeric). For a user-issued access token this is the integer suffix of the JWT 'sub' claim (`u-{userId}`) or the legacy 'user' claim. Service-account tokens cannot call this endpoint.

get.summary: List projects accessible by the authenticated user
get.description:
Returns the projects accessible by the user identified by `{userId}`. The authoritative project ID for legacy Flexera APIs is `legacy.account_id` when present (fall back to top-level `id` when `legacy.account_id` is absent).

NOTE: This endpoint is served by the legacy GRS service, which is being deprecated. Prefer newer Flexera One APIs when available.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Flexera user ID (numeric). For a user-issued access token this is the integer suffix of the JWT 'sub' claim (`u-{userId}`) or the legacy 'user' claim. Service-account tokens cannot call this endpoint.

get.summary: List organizations the authenticated user can access
get.description:
Returns the Flexera One organizations that the user identified by `{userId}` has access to with the caller's credentials. This endpoint is the canonical 'who am I and what orgs do I belong to?' lookup for user-issued tokens (refresh-token grant) and is the recommended first call to validate that a CLI/SDK is configured correctly.

This endpoint requires a user-scoped access token. Service-account tokens (subject prefix `sa-`) do not have a user identity and cannot call this route — callers should detect that case before issuing the request and surface a clear error.

NOTE: Served by the legacy GRS service, which is being deprecated. Prefer newer Flexera One identity APIs when available.

200.description: List of organizations the user can access

orgId.description: Organization ID the project belongs to.

Org.description: Flexera One organization resource (subset returned by GRS user-org index).

href.description: Canonical GRS href for the organization (e.g. `/grs/orgs/{orgId}`).
